items.title: A representable flat, locally finitely presented surjection is surjective on sheaves
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for sheaves F, G on (Sch/S)_{fppf} and a transformation a : F -> G which is representable, flat, locally of finite presentation and surjective, the transformation is surjective as a map of sheaves (source lines 897-904). The proof takes an arbitrary T-valued point g of G, forms the fibre product T' = F x_G T - a scheme by representability - observes that T' -> T is flat, locally finitely presented and surjective, hence an fppf covering, and that g restricted to T' comes from the projection T' -> F.
